notes.title: Patch: Better support for Oculus and Windows MR
notes.content:
[h1]Oculus[/h1]
The Steam version of the game has support for both using SteamVR and the Oculus SDK, it does however automatically choose to use SteamVR if it finds it available. 

If you wish to use the Oculus SDK we generally recommend buying the game on the Oculus Store instead, but if you already own it on Steam you can now start the game with the launch option 
"-vrmode oculus" (without the brackets).

[h1]Windows MR[/h1]
We don't officially have support for Windows MR, but people have told us it worked just fine in the old version, but was broken in this one. This update should hopefully fix that!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug where two of the recipes were swapped on the Winter levels.
[/list]

notes.title: PSVR, Oculus, Bakery and better performance!
notes.content:
[h1]Bakery[/h1]
Your diner has been remodeled to accomodate for the new trend in the robot community. Swedish fika-time.
In this frantic new gamemode you get to serve sweets to your customers in 15 new levels. No need to cook burgers or cut cucumber but there are a lot of cupcakes to sell so don't lose your focus!

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
    [*]A lot smaller file-size. The game only takes about a third of the size on the hard drive compared to previous versions. 
    [*]Major parts of the game have been rewritten, which has resulted in fixing of many bugs and other minor issues.
    [*]Several usability improvements, such as making it easier to select objects that were previously somewhat inconsistent.
[*]Almost all parts of the game have been heavily optimized.
[*]If you were having performance issues previously, your experience should be a lot smoother now.
[/list]

[h1]Oculus Rift[/h1]
The game now fully supports the Oculus SDK. Therefore you can play the game with Oculus Rift without the need of SteamVR. The game will also automaticly detect your hardware and the overall experience on the oculus has been improved.

The game is also released on Oculus Store 15th decemeber.

[h1]PSVR[/h1]
We are happy to announce that VR The Diner Duo is available on the PlayStation 4 for the PSVR on the 15th december (US) and 18 december (EU).

    [*] 5 new recipes
    [*] A holiday decorated restaurant
    [*] Option to enable 'Left handed' mode

We hope you will enjoy this new content and that you all have a great holiday!

notes.title: Score- & star system
notes.content:
So, we have two systems so both new players and experienced players can get a challenge in the game and have replayability.

Firstly: The star system

You can get three stars max at a level, that is if no customers leave.
If one customer leave - you get two stars.
If two customers leave - you get one star.
If three customers leave - you lose the level.

That means that you can still clear the level and unlock the next, even though some customers got angry or you did some mistakes along the way.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Secondly: The score system

Our customers have three moods. You get different score depending on their mood when you serve them and how fast you serve them. Everyone starts happy, if you take too long they'll turn annoyed and then angry.

Moods and score:
- You serve a happy customer you get 100 points + bonus.
- You serve an annoyed customer you get 50 points.
- You serve an angry customers you get 20 points.

Bonus points:
Serving bonus - If you serve a happy customer, you can get bonus points. You get 100 points for serving a happy customer, as always, plus e.g 15  points for serving fast. The size of the bonus depends on how fast you serve a happy customer, which level it is and how you serve them (style bonus)

Style bonus - You can e.g throw burgers to the customers and get extra bonus points. These are always a fixed sum. Throwing is 20 points.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

The two systems are not depending on eachother.
You can get three stars and really high score, or three stars and low score. You can get one star and still have the super high score. It depends a lot on how you play.
